title: BEST INFINITE ALL MOB FARM 1.21! Minecraft Tutorial - 299%!
description:
In This Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the next generation of mob farming inspired by the Gnembon module. It uses a unique pattern to spread water over all platforms only using a dispenser. Besides that, it makes it possible to have multiple platforms and layers near each other, making it an absolute beast that causes a 200% to 299% increase in efficiency, and it is way cheaper than the original module in Minecraft!

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
